title: a turn run by hand names its failure and stops there
line: tools/turn.py on a person, run by hand, that fails outside its runs' own reading and requests and its tail's parts stops there as the runner's turn does: what it had not committed is rolled back and the failure is printed with its exception, the process exiting with a failure status instead of a traceback; a turn that runs to its end exits with none
